run_laikago_pmtg_simulation: run the laikago PMTG open-loop controller simulation with gradually increasing trajectory generator intensity
run_main_function: run the main function to execute a Laikago quadruped robot simulation using the PMTG wrapper and zero residuals
create_gin_config_environment: create a gym environment by parsing gin config files for the Laikago robot with IMU and PMTG wrapper
bind_simulation_parameters: bind simulation parameters like rendering and max step terminal condition using gin.bind_parameter
step_environment_with_action: step the environment with a combined residual and trajectory generator parameters action vector
